subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should this PR be rebuilt back to the narrow pairing fix, or should maintainers intentionally review and keep the broad current-head automation/app/dependency payload?
rationale: The current head contains the useful pairing fix but also a conflicting 353-file commit with write-capable workflow and dependency surfaces; automation should not decide whether that broad payload belongs in this bug-fix PR.

options.title: Rebuild narrow pairing fix
options.body: Keep only the pairing store/source-test changes needed for the allowFrom preservation bug, preserve co-author credit, and rerun exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Review broad head intentionally
options.body: Treat this as a large multi-area PR and require owners/security review plus proof for automation, native i18n, dependency, extension, and Telegram-visible behavior before merge.

options.title: Close and reopen clean
options.body: Close this branch as too polluted and ask for a fresh PR or maintainer replacement that carries only the useful pairing commits.

recommendation.title: Rebuild narrow pairing fix
recommendation.body: Keep only the pairing store/source-test changes needed for the allowFrom preservation bug, preserve co-author credit, and rerun exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns this PR branch, is assigned, and has both workflow CODEOWNER context and prior allowFrom history.
